newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Hind Motor to make Mitsubishi car.
newsitem.headline: India's Hind Motor to make Mitsubishi car.

text.p: India's Hindustan Motors Ltd said on Friday it is building a new 3.0 billion rupee car plant near Madras in southern Tamil Nadu state to manufacture the latest Lancer model of Mitsubishi Motors Corp's.
"Mitsubishi launched this latest model of Lancer in Japan earlier this year. The new model has gained immediate popularity in every country it has been launched," the company said in a statement.
"Hindustan Motors and Mitsubishi Motors Corp are working closely to set up this facility quickly and launch the new Lancer by end of 1997 or early 1998," the company said.
The new plant will manufacture 8,000 cars in the first year, after which the production will be steadily raised to 30,000 units, the statement said.
"Vendor development and localisation activities are in full swing and the detailed planning of the manufacturing facility and selection of the plant and machinery is nearly complete."
